description: The lab kinds and lab sets that the Lab Selector offers. A lab kind groups lab sets (SRG labs, certification labs, learning labs). A lab set is the labs of one volume: its requirement lab chapters and, if it has one, the Chapter 999 that builds its own hosts. scripts/python/sync_lab_selector.py reads this file, the lab chapters it names, and their Chapter 999 tables, and copies the result into the Lab Selector page. A kind with no lab set is shown on the page and cannot be chosen yet.

kinds.name: SRG labs
kinds.sub: Prove the DISA SRG requirements of a product

kinds.name: Certification labs
kinds.sub: Labs that follow a vendor certification track

kinds.name: Learning labs
kinds.sub: Hands-on labs of the instructional volumes

base.note: The shared lab that every lab set runs on. The labs named in always build the gateway, the VLANs, and the service hosts, so every build has them. The other labs of the chapter prepare the switches, so they belong to the lab set named in set.

sets.name: FortiSwitch
sets.about: Requirement labs on two FortiSwitch units: Layer 2 switch, network device management, router, and AAA services. Chapter 08 adds optional console server labs.

sets.name: FortiAnalyzer
sets.about: Requirement labs on a FortiAnalyzer-VM: the Central Log Server SRG and its Network Device Management requirements. The labs reuse the service hosts of the shared lab.

sets.name: FortiManager
sets.about: Requirement labs on a FortiManager-VM that manages a FortiGate-VM: the Network Device Management SRG. The labs reuse the service hosts of the shared lab.
